verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy axis for a coding agent, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions a telemetry or usage-tracking setting, or a way to disable it. Local-model support and BYOK are adjacent privacy features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
